svg.title: RadioMaster XR4 to Raspberry Pi 4 GPIO wiring
svg.desc: Required connections are XR4 5V to Pi physical pin 2, XR4 ground minus to physical pin 6, and XR4 main TX to physical pin 33, GPIO13 UART5 receive. Optional return link is Pi physical pin 32, GPIO12 UART5 transmit, to XR4 main RX. All forty physical pin numbers and GPIO functions are shown. Physical pins 8 and 10 belong to UART0 used by the HAT.

g.text: Use the Pi’s physical header numbers to find the correct pins.
Pi top view · schematic, not to scale
TX goes to RX; both share ground.
Use main TX/RX pads; leave TX2/RX2 unused.
Enlarged and rotated · pin 1 at top left
Gray UART0 pins 8 / 10: reserved for the motor HAT.
GPIO12 / 13 act as UART5 after the guide’s configuration.
Power off before wiring. Numbers in circles are PHYSICAL pins; GPIO labels are BCM numbers.
Colors identify connections in this diagram; match the receiver’s pad labels, not wire colors.
